entities.summary: Suehiro Maruo (b. 1956-01-28, Nagasaki) was a musician or composer of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Nagasaki and Japan. Known in the fields of japan, painters & sculptors, asia.
